_meta.description: DepEd Division LRP (Learner Rights & Protection) Report Schema for Make.com Webhook → Excel
_meta.instructions: Send one report object at a time to your Make.com webhook. The 'report_type' field tells Make.com which Excel sheet/table to route the data to. All M/F fields are integers. 'action_taken' and 'remarks' are free-text strings.
_meta.webhook_tip: In Make.com, use a Router module after the Webhook to branch by 'report_type', then map each branch to its own Excel 'Add a Row' module.

bullying._description: Division Consolidated Report on Incidents of Bullying (DepEd Memo No.59 s.2015 Enclosure 2A). One row = one school entry.

field_definitions.school_level: Kindergarten, Elementary, Junior High School, or Senior High School
field_definitions.physical_male: Count of male victims of physical bullying
field_definitions.physical_female: Count of female victims of physical bullying
field_definitions.social_male: Count of male victims of social bullying
field_definitions.social_female: Count of female victims of social bullying
field_definitions.gender_based_male: Count of male victims of gender-based bullying
field_definitions.gender_based_female: Count of female victims of gender-based bullying
field_definitions.cyber_bullying_male: Count of male victims of cyberbullying
field_definitions.cyber_bullying_female: Count of female victims of cyberbullying
field_definitions.retaliation_male: Count of male victims of retaliation
field_definitions.retaliation_female: Count of female victims of retaliation
field_definitions.total_male_victims: Sum of all male victims across all bullying types
field_definitions.total_female_victims: Sum of all female victims across all bullying types
field_definitions.cases_for_monitoring: Number of cases still being monitored
field_definitions.referred_government_agencies: Number of cases referred to government agencies
field_definitions.referred_ngo: Number of cases referred to non-government agencies
field_definitions.action_taken: Free text description of action taken

child_abuse._description: Division Consolidated Report on Incidents of Child Abuse (DepEd Memo No.59 s.2015 Enclosure 2B). One row = one school entry.

field_definitions.perpetrator_relatives: Number of incidents where perpetrator is a relative
field_definitions.perpetrator_school_personnel: Number of incidents where perpetrator is school personnel
field_definitions.cases_for_monitoring: Number of cases still being monitored
field_definitions.action_taken: Free text description of action taken

other_lrp_concerns._description: Division Consolidated Report on Other LRP Concerns. One row = one school entry.

field_definitions.online_sexual_exploitation_male: Male victims of online sexual exploitation (OSEC)
field_definitions.other_learner_to_learner_abuse_male: Male victims of other learner-to-learner abuse
field_definitions.other_learner_to_learner_abuse_female: Female victims of other learner-to-learner abuse

children_at_risk._description: Division Consolidated Report on Cases of Children-at-Risk (CAR). One row = one risk classification per school.

field_definitions.period_covered: Reporting period e.g. SY 2024-2025 or Q1 2025
field_definitions.victim_of_abuse_male: Male students who are victims of abuse (sexual, physical, psychological, mental, economic)
field_definitions.victim_of_abuse_female: Female students who are victims of abuse
field_definitions.victim_of_neglect_male: Male students who are victims of neglect
field_definitions.victim_of_neglect_female: Female students who are victims of neglect
field_definitions.dysfunctional_family_male: Male students from dysfunctional family or without parent/guardian
field_definitions.dysfunctional_family_female: Female students from dysfunctional family or without parent/guardian
field_definitions.gang_member_male: Male students who are gang members
field_definitions.gang_member_female: Female students who are gang members
field_definitions.high_criminality_community_male: Male students living in high-criminality community
field_definitions.high_criminality_community_female: Female students living in high-criminality community
field_definitions.armed_conflict_male: Male students living in armed conflict situation
field_definitions.armed_conflict_female: Female students living in armed conflict situation
field_definitions.status_offense_ra9344_male: Male students who committed status offense under Sec.57 RA 9344
field_definitions.mendicant_pd1563_male: Male students who are mendicants under PD 1563
field_definitions.drug_use_dependency_male: Male students with marijuana/drug use or dependency
field_definitions.drug_use_dependency_female: Female students with marijuana/drug use or dependency
field_definitions.others_male: Male students under other CAR categories
field_definitions.others_female: Female students under other CAR categories
field_definitions.division_alleviation_actions: Narrative description of division actions to alleviate CAR risk factors

cicl._description: Division Consolidated Report on Children in Conflict with the Law (CICL). One row = one CICL case.

field_definitions.learner_reference_number: DepEd LRN of the learner involved
field_definitions.sex: M for Male, F for Female
field_definitions.case_violation: Description of the case or violation committed
field_definitions.intervention_diversion_program: Name or type of intervention or diversion program applied
field_definitions.cases_for_monitoring: Number of cases for continued monitoring
field_definitions.diversion_program_description: Narrative: description of division-initiated diversion/reintegration programs

cp_policy_status._description: Division Consolidated Report on Schools with CP Policy, Anti-Bullying Policy, and CPC. One row = one school.

field_definitions.has_cp_policy_with_anti_bullying: true if school has BOTH Child Protection Policy AND Anti-Bullying Policy
field_definitions.has_cp_policy_only: true if school has Child Protection Policy only
field_definitions.has_anti_bullying_policy_only: true if school has Anti-Bullying Policy only
field_definitions.has_no_policy: true if school has no policy at all
field_definitions.has_child_protection_committee: true if school has an established Child Protection Committee

make_com_setup_guide.step_1_webhook: Create a Webhook (Custom) module in Make.com. Copy the webhook URL and paste it into your website's form submission handler.
make_com_setup_guide.step_2_router: After the Webhook module, add a Router. Create one route per report_type (bullying, child_abuse, other_lrp_concerns, children_at_risk, cicl, cp_policy_status).
make_com_setup_guide.step_3_filter: On each router branch, set a Filter: report_type = [the matching type]. Use 'Text operator: Equal to'.
make_com_setup_guide.step_4_excel: In each branch, add a Microsoft Excel 'Add a Row' module (or Google Sheets 'Append a Row'). Map each JSON field to its corresponding column in your spreadsheet.
make_com_setup_guide.step_5_columns: Pre-create your Excel file with column headers matching the field names exactly from each schema's sample_payload. One sheet per report_type.
make_com_setup_guide.tip_auto_totals: For total_male_victims, total_female_victims, and total_incidents, you can either calculate on the website before sending, or use Excel formulas in a separate summary row.
